**Date:** {{< meta display-date >}}  
**From:** {{< meta from-address >}}  
**Manuscript Location:** {{< meta manuscript-location >}}  

My dear [[name erased](../persons.html#1301)]
I am sending you [Keightley](../others.html#212) by this post, I must ask Macmillan to send you Pearson as I have only got a [Mudie](../others.html#137)’s copy here –[^2] I think I shall go to [Brighstone](../others.html#140) in Whitsunweek, when I would try to get to Bonchurch to see you

Yours sincerely

C M Yonge

[^1]: CMY visited the Moberlys at Brightstone in May 1869.

[^2]: Probably Thomas Keightley, The Crusaders, or, Scenes, Events and Characters from the Times of the Crusades (London: Parker, 1834).
